hero.name: Carlos
hero.description: Passionate Fullstack Developer who loves building robust and scalable digital solutions. I turn ideas into real products with clean code and best practices.
hero.cinemaSubtitle: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A little about who I am
about.paragraph1: I'm a Fullstack Developer with over years of experience building modern web applications. I specialize in the JavaScript/TypeScript stack on both the frontend with React and the backend with Node.js, Java.
about.paragraph2: I'm passionate about writing clean, scalable, and well-documented code. I enjoy solving complex problems and always look for opportunities to learn new technologies.
about.paragraph3: When I'm not coding, I like to contribute to open source projects, write technical articles, and keep growing as a professional.

studio.title: Director's Cut
studio.subtitle: Order the scenes to assemble the flow of a full-stack app.
studio.idleCopy: Move the scenes until the product journey makes sense. Then review the cut.

scenes.title: Brief and architecture
scenes.cue: Understand the problem, user, scope, and technical decisions.

scenes.title: Intentional interface
scenes.cue: Design clear, accessible screens that are ready to use.

scenes.title: API and business rules
scenes.cue: Shape endpoints, validation, errors, and clean contracts.

scenes.title: Persistent data
scenes.cue: Store, query, and protect the information that matters.

scenes.title: Deploy and observe
scenes.cue: Ship, measure, adjust, and keep the product alive.

perfect.title: Final cut approved
perfect.copy: That's the rhythm: Carlos connects product, frontend, backend, data, and delivery without losing continuity.

close.title: Strong edit
close.copy: The story is nearly there. A technical transition needs polish, exactly where full-stack judgment helps.

retry.title: Needs another take
retry.copy: Some scenes are still out of continuity. Reorder them and find the natural flow of a real app.
